test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) K & ^ 5 T & B 4 @ 3 # 1 A 3 P H 9 L % 9 2 (Right)

If all letters are dropped from the series, which of the following will be fifth from the left?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) K & ^ 5 T & B 4 @ 3 # 1 A 3 P H 9 L % 9 2 (Right)

If all the letters are dropped from the series then the arrangements are:

(Left) & ^ 5 & 4 @ 3 # 1 3 9 % 9 2 (Right)

Here,

Fifth from the Left end is: 4.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
